name: constellation
submitted_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the ORIGINAL card illustration and the strict EDIT TARGET. The previous pass only swapped characters and looked plain and standard: this pass must feel INVENTIVE, reinterpreting the replaced subject as a specific Persona 3 Reload moment, character or object, while the card stays instantly recognizable at thumbnail size: same silhouettes, same action, same footprint, same camera. Keep the exact background: its palette, large shapes, lighting direction, cast shadows, magical effects, enemies and core objects stay as in Image1 unless this prompt names them. Do NOT redraw the scene, do NOT recolor globally, do NOT move or rescale anything beyond what is stated. Completely remove the replaced Regent parts (old brown/gold four-point hat-head, gold gauntlets, blue robe, armor) with no remnants left behind, and refill the cleared area with the original background shapes. Match the original's rich hard cel-shading: crisp dark outlines, deep near-black occlusion planes, clear midtone and lit planes, material thickness, purposeful small details; no blur, no soft glow, no photoreal rendering. Makoto Yuki's face and head never appear (hands and sleeves only); other characters' faces are allowed. Persona creatures' hands are plump cartoon mittens with no long human fingers. If a named character's design is uncertain, follow the described features, keep the rest simple, and never invent text. Keep important features inside x8-92%, y10-85% (crop-safe). Output: opaque, full-bleed, horizontal 1000x760, no text, letters, numbers, frame, UI or watermark. Never use Pyro Jack, Jack Frost or Pixie in this card. Replace the two hands with two hands meeting over one card: the lower-left fist becomes MAKOTO HAND, the upper-right reaching hand becomes YUKARI TAKEBA's hand (slim, with a pale-pink cardigan sleeve and a thin bracelet), both holding the two ends of one glowing tarot card (The Lovers: two small figures under a sun, gold on royal blue, no text) where the cyan tiles were. The small hanging constellation figure becomes a few gold sparkles rising from the card. Keep the violet-blue cloth behind and the background. Character and object designs: [MAKOTO HAND] = MAKOTO YUKI's natural warm pale bare hand(s) with black school-blazer sleeve and white shirt cuff (a small red armband only if the upper arm is visible); NO Makoto face, head, hair or neck anywhere, sleeves leave the canvas at the same edges where the original arms did.
Image2 is a design reference ONLY for Makoto's natural hand, black school-blazer sleeve and white shirt cuff. Never include his face, head, hair or portrait framing. Image1 is the sole edit target. The other hand belongs to Yukari and has the pink cardigan sleeve and bracelet specified above.
